family.scope: per search, over every forward experiment it may run

honesty: Experiments ran in containers built from the capsules, not on the original host.
A bundle is never one cause: a CONFIRMED EFFECT (bundle) names every attribute that differed between the arms and says which were not isolated.

Isolation holds among the attributes the capsules captured (isolatedAmong); a cause that no capsule shows is not excluded, and a verdict whose arms were not both captured says isolation was not measured.
The bound on a false CONFIRMED holds per search (family.falseConfirmedBound), not per experiment; each forward experiment is tested at the plan's alpha divided by the family size.
Candidate weights and the prior are hand-set and uncalibrated; the posteriors order experiments and are not measurements.
Only experiments that ran are recorded, each with every trial; nothing here was inferred from an experiment that did not run.
verify can re-derive hashes, posteriors and test statistics from this data; it does not re-run the experiments.

verdict.label: CONFIRMED EFFECT (bundle)
verdict.statement: the arms differ in 5 attributes, so the effect is the bundle's and not one member's: env.NODE_VERSION, env.YARN_VERSION, tool.node.version, tool.npm.version, tz.database.version. Setting tool.node.version moved the failure count from 0 of 7 to 7 of 7 (exact one-sided p 0.000291) and back from 7 of 7 to 0 of 7 when the failing side was set to the passing values (p 0.000291). No bundle-splitting arm was possible: only tool.node.version can be set on its own; the other members travel with the base image. Member tests: tool.npm.version alone reproduces the failure (set alone on the passing side: 7 of 7 against 0 of 7, p 0.000291). env.NODE_VERSION alone does not decide it (the failure did not follow (reverted alone on the failing side: 7 of 7 against 7 of 7)). env.YARN_VERSION alone does not decide it (the failure did not follow (reverted alone on the failing side: 7 of 7 against 7 of 7)). Not tested alone: tz.database.version (no typed intervention changes tz.database.version).
